basic_profile.bio: Avid fan of manga and anime, especially Attack on Titan. I spend most of my time diving deep into theories and fan discussions. Originally from Manila, Philippines, where I work as a part-time graphic designer. I'm usually online during late evenings and early mornings, as my work schedule is quite flexible. Currently single, I enjoy my solitude but love connecting with fellow fans online. I often browse online marketplaces and have a fascination with retro infomercials.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in anime and manga, with a particular focus on Shingeki No Kyojin. I've read the manga multiple times and actively participate in fan theories. My knowledge comes from years of self-study and interactions with other fans on forums and social media.
